greeting.text: Morning. You're up early.
Good morning, traveller.
Morning, {player}! Sleep well?
Afternoon. Warm one, isn't it?
Good afternoon. Can I help you with something?
Evening. The lamps will be lit soon.
Evening, {player}. Come to sit by the fire a while?
It's late to be wandering about. Mind the dark.
Can't sleep either? The night's restless.
Wet enough for you? Come under the eaves.
Rain again. Good for the fields, bad for my boots.
Rain's soaking the mortar. We'll lose a day's work to it.
Hear that thunder? Stay close to the walls.
What a day! The sun's out and so is everyone else.
Hm. Another stranger.
What do you want? I've work to do.
Oh, it's you. Well, go on, then.
Hello! Isn't it a fine day to be alive?
Oh, hello! I was hoping someone would come by.
Oh! Um. Hello.
Hello again, {player}. I'm glad it's you.
Come, come, sit! Tell me everything you've seen.
Have you heard the latest? No? Oh, I've news for you.
Blessings on you, wanderer.
May the hearth keep you warm, {player}.
A traveller! Where have you come from? What's it like?
If you've coin to spend, you've come to the right person.
You look tired. Here, have you eaten?
Mm? Oh, hello. I was just resting my eyes.
Make it quick, there's plenty still to do today.
Steady, now. These roads aren't safe.
Ha! A fellow who walks the wilds. My kind of company.
I was watching the clouds. That one looks like a sheep, doesn't it?
We don't care for your sort here.
I've heard about you. Keep your hands where I can see them.
You've a nerve, showing your face round here.
Welcome to {settlement}, stranger.
Not from round here, are you?
Ah, {player}. Good to see you again.
{player}! Always a pleasure.
There's our friend! The whole of {settlement} owes you, you know.
{player}, our hero! My table is yours, any time.
Mind the forge, it spits.
Hot work today. Stand back from the anvil.
Flour everywhere, sorry. The loaves won't knead themselves.
Fresh from the oven this morning, if you're hungry.
Watch your head, we're raising the beams.
Every block in this town went up by somebody's hands. Mine, mostly.
Wheat's coming on nicely this year.
Halt. Oh, a traveller. Keep the peace and you're welcome.
All quiet on my watch, {player}.
Fresh catch, if you've a taste for it.
Come in, come in. Take a look at my wares.
A table, a bed, a mug of something warm? You've found the right door.
Shh. I'm in the middle of a chapter.
The hearth is warm and the door is open to all.
Mind the sawdust.
Every stone has a grain, if you know where to look.
Every coin that leaves this counter is counted twice.
Letters for the next town? I leave at first light.
Fine cloth, fair prices.
Brewed it myself. Want a taste?
Back from the woods, still smelling of pine.
Mind the flock, they spook easy.
Hi! Do you want to play?
Are you an adventurer? Have you fought a creeper?
Mum says I'm not to talk to strangers. But you look nice.
{player}! {player}! Watch me run!
You're tall.
Sit with me a moment, young one. My knees aren't what they were.
In my day this was all fields, you know.
I've seen sixty winters in {settlement} and never one like the last.
Peace to you. The blossom's out along the lane.
Hail. Warm yourself by the hall fire.
Grüss you, wanderer. The pass is clear today.
Mind the bog, it's soft after the rain.
The tide's out. Good day for the nets.
Aloha, friend. The water's warm today.
Peace be upon you. Come out of the sun.
Buongiorno! Have you tried the olives?
The steppe is wide and you are welcome in it.
Welcome. Mind the steps, they are steep and many.
Well hey there, cher. Come on up out the water.
Buenos días. The canyon's cool in the shade.
You stand before the lord of {settlement}. Speak your business.
Ah, {player}. My hall is open to friends of {settlement}.
I have little time for strangers. Make it brief.
The reeve's busy, but go on. What is it?
Order in {settlement}, {player}. Keep it that way.
Mind your step near the cells.
Spare a moment, stranger? Times are hard.
Good day. You've the look of someone who travels. Fine weather for it.
Careful. The tunnels don't care who you are.
Out of the way, friend, this load's heavy!
Hush, you'll upset the bees.
Pull up a seat, the next song's a good one!
Looking for something... unusual?
